tags.note: Recurring numbness; coach did not explore
Repeats unwanted advice after participant showed no interest
Fatigue plus fear of ending up like dad

flags.reason: Recurring numbness in feet (possible neuropathy) was acknowledged with 'Got it' and never explored or referred.
Band-exercise suggestion repeated after participant said she was too tired; pushes advice without permission.
Same suggestion repeated a third time after participant said she doesn't see the point.
Fourth repetition of the same suggestion; the participant's resistance was not addressed.
Participant voiced fatigue and fear of ending up like her dad; coach asked for an alternative instead of exploring the fear or fatigue.

score.summary: Coach reflected well early and helped Linda set a concrete goal, with good use of change talk around her grandchildren and her doctor's advice. However, the band-exercise suggestion was repeated four times despite resistance, and the recurring foot numbness and fatigue/fear comments were not explored.
strengths: Line 10 and line 14: complex reflections captured ambivalence and her wish to start small.
Line 35 and line 45: emphasized Linda's autonomy and choice.
Line 58: clear summary before closing confirmed the goal with Linda.
coaching_tips: Line 38, 48, 52: after one offer is declined, ask permission or explore her reasons rather than repeating the same suggestion.
Line 6: ask about the numbness (how often, any falls or changes) and flag it to her care team.
Line 53: reflect her fear of 'ending up like my dad' and ask what that means to her before moving to a new goal.
Line 3 and line 25: check how she is feeling explicitly as planned, and plan for barriers like Sunday church (line 11) before setting the goal.
